{{Top|leg}}
The '''bonded plates''' enhancement increased the protection capabilities of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] against many types of damage. The Mark I, II, III, and IV versions in turn allowed for minor increases in protection. Furthermore, the IV version added additional shielding against physical injury.

{{Clothes-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', this upgrade can only be used on medium and heavy armor.
